title: Sharing musical direction with Paquito D'Rivera

story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: You and Paquito shared musical directorship of United Nations Orchestra?
What was that – what was the nature of that working relationship?

When I wasn’t available, Paquito would do it, or vice versa: when he wasn’t available, I would do it. That’s fine with me. We also do some of the same things now with the Dizzy Gillespie All-Star Big Band. If I can’t go, Paquito will be the musical director, or Jimmy Heath. Because there are a lot of guys in the band that are very good

musicians, know the music, but they don’t want to stand out front there and do that, because it takes a certain amount of not being afraid to stand up front and conduct. Some people haven’t had much experience in conducting, so that there’s only a few people in the band that really can do that job. But whenever one of us are not there, the other one can jump in and do it.
